title: santolina macrophylla
intro: Santolina macrophylla, commonly known as Large Leafed Lavender Cotton or Big Leafed Wormwood, is a perennial plant native to the Mediterranean region, characterized by its grey-green foliage and clusters of small, yellow flowers. The plant is known for its various health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Santolina macrophylla include its use as a carminative to ease digestive issues and as a nervine to calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils such as camphor, borneol, and thujone, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
